name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
blurb: The Hauz Khas campus that set the template for Indian engineering education, and still places a full batch before the final semester ends.

name: University of Delhi
blurb: A federation of more than eighty colleges across the city, from Hindu and St. Stephen's to Kirori Mal, admitting most undergraduates through CUET.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru University
blurb: Known for the social sciences and languages, on a campus that is mostly scrub forest and long arguments.

name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
blurb: India's most competitive medical school and a full working hospital in one, with some of the lowest MBBS fees in the country.

name: Netaji Subhas University of Technology
blurb: A state university in Dwarka that has quietly become one of Delhi's strongest engineering options after DTU.

name: Delhi Technological University
blurb: The oldest engineering college in Delhi, still running a placement season that rivals the IITs for software roles.

name: Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi
blurb: A two-year MBA with fees that look like a misprint, and a selection process built almost entirely on the CAT score.

name: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade
blurb: Specialises in international business, and runs its own entrance test alongside CAT.

name: Jamia Millia Islamia
blurb: A central university with strong architecture and mass communication faculties, built around a 1920s campus in Okhla.

name: Jamia Hamdard
blurb: A deemed university best known for pharmacy and unani medicine, and for its MBBS programme.

name: Amity University, Noida
blurb: One of the largest private universities in the country, with a programme list that runs from engineering to fashion.

name: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology

name: Galgotias University
blurb: A large private university on the Yamuna Expressway, popular for engineering and management seats.

name: Shiv Nadar University
blurb: A research-first private university with small batches and a common liberal-arts year before you pick a major.

name: Bennett University
blurb: The Times Group's university, strong in media and communication alongside engineering.

name: Sharda University
blurb: A large multidisciplinary private university with a significant international student cohort.

name: SGT University
blurb: A Gurugram university best known for its health sciences and dental programmes.

name: The NorthCap University

name: BML Munjal University
blurb: Set up with Hero Group backing, with a curriculum that leans heavily on industry projects.

name: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College
blurb: An AKTU-affiliated engineering college in Ghaziabad with a long-running placement record for its computer science branch.

name: IMT Ghaziabad
blurb: One of the older private business schools in the country, and a fixture of the CAT-based admission circuit.

name: Manav Rachna University
blurb: A Faridabad campus with engineering, dentistry and a well-regarded design school.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
blurb: Powai's lakeside campus, and the institute most engineering aspirants in India name first.

name: Institute of Chemical Technology

name: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute
blurb: One of Asia's oldest engineering colleges, in the middle of Mumbai at Matunga.

name: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies
blurb: A Mumbai deemed university whose business school runs its own entrance test, NMAT.

name: University of Mumbai
blurb: One of the oldest universities in India, affiliating hundreds of colleges across the Mumbai region.

name: Tata Institute of Social Sciences
blurb: India's leading school for social work and public policy, admitting through its own national entrance test.

name: K. J. Somaiya Institute of Technology
blurb: A Vidyavihar campus with engineering, management and a sprawling multi-institute layout.

name: SNDT Women's University

name: Savitribai Phule Pune University

name: College of Engineering, Pune
blurb: The third-oldest engineering college in Asia, and still one of the toughest Maharashtra seats to get.

name: Symbiosis International (Deemed University)

name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune

name: MIT World Peace University

name: Vishwakarma Institute of Technology

name: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed University)

name: Fergusson College

name: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology
blurb: An NIT in the geographic centre of India, on a campus in the west of Nagpur.

name: Government College of Engineering, Aurangabad
blurb: A state engineering college in the Marathwada region, admitting through MHT CET.

name: Indian Institute of Science
blurb: India's premier research institute, and one of the very few that takes undergraduates at all.

name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore

name: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore

name: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences

name: RV College of Engineering

name: BMS College of Engineering
blurb: The oldest private engineering college in Karnataka, in Basavanagudi.

name: PES University
blurb: A Bengaluru university with a large computer science intake and its own entrance test.

name: Christ University

name: Manipal Academy of Higher Education

name: National Institute of Technology Karnataka

name: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad

name: International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad

name: University of Hyderabad
blurb: A central university with a campus large enough to have its own deer, and strong science and social science faculties.

name: Osmania University

name: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad

name: National Institute of Technology Warangal

name: BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus

name: Mahindra University

name: Woxsen University

name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras

name: Anna University
blurb: Tamil Nadu's technical university, which affiliates the state's engineering colleges and runs TNEA counselling.

name: University of Madras
blurb: One of the three oldest universities in India, with a Senate House on the Marina.

name: Loyola College
blurb: A Jesuit arts and science college in Nungambakkam, and one of the most applied-to in Chennai.

name: SSN College of Engineering
blurb: A private engineering college at Kalavakkam, funded by the Shiv Nadar Foundation.

name: Vellore Institute of Technology

name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

name: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli

name: Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli

name: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

name: PSG College of Technology

name: SASTRA Deemed University

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur

name: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta
blurb: India's first IIM, and the finance-and-analytics destination of the CAT circuit.

name: Jadavpur University

name: University of Calcutta
blurb: The oldest university in India still running a full set of affiliated colleges across Bengal.

name: Indian Statistical Institute

name: National Institute of Technology Durgapur
blurb: An NIT in the industrial belt of West Bengal, on the bank of the Damodar.

name: Panjab University
blurb: A Chandigarh campus with a student population large enough to run its own shopping centre.

name: Punjab Engineering College

name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Mohali

name: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology

name: Lovely Professional University

name: Chitkara University
blurb: A Punjab private university with engineering and health sciences campuses along the NH-7 corridor.

name: Chandigarh University
blurb: A large private university near Mohali, with an engineering intake in the thousands and its own entrance test.

name: Guru Nanak Dev University
blurb: A state university in Amritsar with a large affiliated college network across Punjab.

name: Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College
blurb: One of Punjab's older engineering colleges, on the road out of Ludhiana.

name: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad

name: Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur

name: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

name: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur

name: University of Rajasthan

name: Manipal University Jaipur
blurb: The Jaipur campus of the Manipal group, with engineering, design and management programmes.

name: Poornima University
blurb: A Jaipur private university with an engineering focus and its own entrance test.

name: Indian Institute of Management Udaipur

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur

name: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow

name: University of Lucknow

name: Institute of Engineering and Technology, Lucknow

name: Amity University Lucknow

name: Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad

name: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi

name: Dayalbagh Educational Institute

name: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology

name: Indian Institute of Management Indore

name: Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya

name: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science

name: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology
blurb: An NIT overlooking Bhopal's upper lake, with a strong planning and architecture faculty.

name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
blurb: A basic-sciences institute on the edge of Bhopal, admitting through the IISER aptitude test.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee

name: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies
blurb: A Dehradun university built around energy, law and aviation programmes.

name: Graphic Era Deemed to be University

name: Doon University
blurb: A state university in Dehradun focused on environment, languages and management.

name: Indian Institute of Management Kashipur
blurb: An IIM in the Terai region, with a growing analytics and operations focus.

name: National Institute of Technology Hamirpur

name: Indian Institute of Technology Mandi

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar
blurb: A newer IIT on a campus at Argul, with a strong earth and climate sciences department.

name: National Institute of Technology Rourkela
blurb: One of the largest NIT campuses, sitting in the middle of Odisha's steel belt.

name: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology

name: Siksha 'O' Anusandhan
blurb: A Bhubaneswar deemed university best known for its medical and dental colleges.

name: Utkal University
blurb: Odisha's oldest university, on a large campus at Vani Vihar.

name: Indian Institute of Management Sambalpur
blurb: One of the youngest IIMs, with a new campus in western Odisha.

name: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad
blurb: The red-brick Louis Kahn campus, and the business school every other Indian B-school is measured against.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar
blurb: An IIT on the Sabarmati riverfront with an unusually flexible undergraduate curriculum.

name: Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology
blurb: A specialist institute for information technology and design, admitting through JEE Main and its own test.

name: Gujarat University
blurb: Ahmedabad's affiliating university, with a large campus in Navrangpura.

name: Nirma University
blurb: An Ahmedabad private university with strong engineering, pharmacy and law faculties.

name: Ahmedabad University
blurb: A liberal-arts-first private university in the middle of Ahmedabad.

name: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology
blurb: An NIT in Gujarat's diamond city, with a large campus on the bank of the Tapi.

name: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda
blurb: A Vadodara university with one of India's most respected fine arts faculties.

name: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode
blurb: A hilltop campus in Kerala, and the IIM that has consistently punched above its batch size.

name: National Institute of Technology Calicut
blurb: An NIT in north Kerala, strong in architecture as well as engineering.

name: Cochin University of Science and Technology
blurb: A Kerala university built around marine sciences, technology and law.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Palakkad
blurb: One of the newer IITs, with a campus in the Nila river valley.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati
blurb: A campus on the north bank of the Brahmaputra, and the strongest design school in the IIT system.

name: Indian Institute of Management Shillong
blurb: An IIM in the Khasi hills, with a focus on sustainability and tourism management.

name: National Institute of Technology Silchar
blurb: An NIT in the Barak valley of Assam, with a large and unusually green campus.

name: National Institute of Technology Patna

name: Indian Institute of Technology Patna

name: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad

name: National Institute of Technology Raipur
blurb: An NIT in the Chhattisgarh capital, with a substantial engineering and architecture intake.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai

name: Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati

name: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar

name: SRM University, Andhra Pradesh

name: Xavier School of Management

name: National Institute of Technology Agartala
blurb: An NIT in Tripura with one of the largest campuses in the north-east.

name: Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam

name: Andhra University

name: National Institute of Technology Nagaland

name: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu
blurb: A young IIT on the outskirts of Jammu, with a new campus in the Jagti foothills.

name: University of Kashmir
blurb: The main university of the Kashmir valley, on the shores of Dal Lake.
